condition.expression: no_confirmed_short AND vin_present AND vcc_present AND NOT en_measured

next_steps.action: Measure the standby controller's EN pin. ALW rails are typically self-enabled (EN tied to VCC) or always-on; if EN is EC-controlled, it should be high.

measure.expected: Active-high EN high when on; many ALW controllers self-enable (EN tied to VCC).
measure.safety: ALW controllers are usually always-on, so EN should be high whenever VCC is up.

interpretations.then: Controller is enabled. Proceed to check switching.
EC is holding the rail off, or EN is externally pulled low. ALW rails being held off is unusual; suspect EC firmware fault or a stuck power button.

next_steps.requires_info_note: Need controller datasheet for EN pin and active polarity.
